body { margin: 0; min-height: 100vh; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; }
main { min-height: 100vh; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; }
header { padding: 18px clamp(14px, 3vw, 34px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 20px; }
h1 { margin: 0; font-size: clamp(24px, 5vw, 54px); letter-spacing: 0; line-height: .95; }
.sub { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--muted); max-width: 920px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; }
.pill { border: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--green); padding: 8px 10px; white-space: nowrap; }
.grid { min-height: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(360px, .75fr); }
.chrome { height: 100%; min-height: 560px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: #080b0a; display: grid; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr auto; }
.bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--muted); }
.dot:nth-child(1) { background: var(--red); } .dot:nth-child(2) { background: var(--amber); } .dot:nth-child(3) { background: var(--green); }
.prompt { color: var(--green); } .tool { color: var(--blue); } .ok { color: var(--green); } .warn { color: var(--amber); } .dim { color: var(--muted); }
.input { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted); }
.cursor { display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 16px; background: var(--green); animation: blink 1s steps(2, start) infinite; transform: translateY(3px); }
.panel h2 { margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 14px; color: var(--green); }
.kv div { padding: 9px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(39,48,44,.72); min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.k { color: var(--muted); text-align: right; background: rgba(255,255,255,.02); }
.meters { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px; padding: 12px; }
.meter span { display: block; color: var(--muted); font-size: 11px; }
.meter strong { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-size: 22px; color: var(--green); }

@media (max-width: 880px) { header { display: block; } .pill { display: inline-block; margin-top: 12px; } .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .terminal { border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .chrome { min-height: 520px; } .kv { grid-template-columns: 108px 1fr; } }
